packages.name: Now Playing
packages.description: Shows the song playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, any app that shows up in Windows' media controls): title, artist, time, a progress bar and an audio spectrum.
packages.author: Yuniverse

firmware.name: REVIVER v15
firmware.notes: GIF screen: store an animation on the keyboard and it plays by itself, even with the PC off (replaces the Monitor screen; upload from the GIF screen tab). Fixes a crash when switching to the GIF screen from the app, and makes all of REVIVER's flash-chip access safe alongside the firmware's own. Also: live drawing for packages, tear-free scrolling, Yuniverse boot logo, screen button skips KPM and clock, blank Custom Text screen for Now Playing, screen-off support.
